rejected.title: Digital technologies and health
card: Digital technologies include the internet, mobile phones, apps and video calls. They can carry health information, services and education across long distances quickly.
Telehealth
health care given by phone or video, so a person can see a doctor or nurse without travelling. It can help people in remote areas.
Digital tools can also teach health workers and the public, for example through online courses or text message advice on pregnancy and child health.
Digital divide

the gap between people who have good access to digital technology and those who do not. It exists between countries and within them, as access depends on things like income, location and internet coverage.
rejected.remember: Digital tools can spread health care, information and education, but access to them is uneven.

a.q: Why might a digital health program fail to reach some people in a low-income country?
opts: Weak internet coverage or devices people cannot afford
Digital tools cannot carry information over long distances
Telehealth is designed for city hospitals, not rural areas
The digital divide exists only within wealthy countries
a.why: Access to digital technology is uneven, and it depends on things like income and internet coverage. The idea that digital tools cannot carry information far is wrong, as they can spread it quickly across long distances.
a.clue: Think about what shapes who can use digital tools.

b.q: Tane lives on a remote farm in Western Australia with weak internet. How might this affect his health care compared with a person in Perth?
opts: Video care may be harder for him, a divide within Australia
There may be no gap, as the divide is only between countries
His care may be easier, as remote areas get faster internet
He may get no telehealth, as it is offered only in cities
b.why: Weak internet can make video consults harder for Tane, which is an example of the digital divide within a country. He may still be able to use telehealth by phone. The divide is not only between countries: it exists within them too.
b.clue: Where can the digital divide exist?
